expect_red: re-laying a walk in its own order on its own columns reproduces it row for row, rail for rail

mutations.contract: VA.layWalk, handed a walk's own order and its own columns as the preference, reproduces the walk: the re-layer honours a preferred column wherever it is free.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff the_active_study_is_a_compact_band_and_the_rest_of_the_model_hangs_above_and_below (2026-10-28). An edge stops trying its preferred column, so every fork lands on the lowest free one instead of the walk's own.
mutations.find: if (col === undefined) col = pick([prefer(edge), c], r, bottom, row.id);
mutations.replace: if (col === undefined) col = pick([c], r, bottom, row.id);
